title.native: 機巧少女は傷つかない

description:
During the early 20th century, along with technological advancements, scientists were able to develop sophisticated magic. The combination of science and sorcery was Machinart, circuits made from spells that were put into objects to bring them to life and even gain a personality. It was developed as a military weapon and has now spread throughout the world.

Akabane Raishin is now attending the Royal Academy to become the best in the world. Accompanied by the lovely teenage girl Yaya, who is actually Raishin’s puppet weapon, he plans on rocketing to the top of the class. However, his test scores come nearly dead last although his combat skills and determination are second to none. Raishin has to compete with the deadliest of classmates if he wants to come out as the king.

(Source: Moetron)

node.description: Raishin is a survivor of the Akabane clan, a prestigious clan of puppeteers. He attends the Royal Academy in hopes to improve his skills and become the best in the world and with intent to avenge his family. Despite his poor examination results and lack of experience, he has excellent combat skills. His unique fighting style combines magic and martial arts.

Yaya is Raishin's puppet who takes the form of a raven-haired teenage girl. She is abnormal in the sense that her appearance and personality strongly resemble that of a human. She adores Raishin and often teases him.
Yaya was named for her indestructibility. She is a Banned doll, meaning she is a puppet who has human components. She has real human blood and skin.

name.native: シャルロット・ブリュー

node.description: She is a second year puppeteer in The Royal Academy of Machinart and also ranked withing the top thirteen members (the Rounds) of the Night Party. The automaton she owns' is a dragon-type automaton called Sigmund. She wants to become the Wiseman.
Third Year puppeteer and Loki's older sister. Just like him, she has red eye color and pearl gray hair.  Frey's automaton is Rabbi, a dog-type automatic doll.
Frey's brother and member of the thirteen party (Rounds). His automaton is Cherubim, a humanoid type doll with plate armour appearance.

Irori is a woman who has a pale skin tone, long, flowing silver hair, purple eyes and wears light-colored lipstick. Her choice of attire is an indigo-colored kimono that is secured by a teal-colored obi. She also embellishes her clothing with a dark-colored cloth that has an baroque design in it and depicts her symbol, two snowflakes. Her dress is a tone darker to her kimono and completes her look by wearing a tabi and geta.

Komurasaki is Yaya's and Irori's younger sister, she is the youngest Automaton "daughter" of Shoko Karyusai.
cheerful and optimistic girl who smiles frequently, She is rather cheeky and tends to make sexual jokes.
